```plato

//==
// # Blend and growth surfaces

// A ring Dupin cyclide: the image of a torus under an inversion, and the
// classical CAD blend surface — every parameter line is a circle. Requires
// MajorRadius > MinorRadius > 0; Offset is the cyclide's d parameter, and equal
// radii collapse the construction back to an ordinary torus
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dupin_cyclide).
type DupinCyclide
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    MajorRadius: Number;
    MinorRadius: Number;
    Offset: Number;
}
```
